INSERT INTO document_chunk (knowledge_base_id, document_id, chunk_index, content, token_count, embedding, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES
(#{c.knowledgeBaseId}, #{c.documentId}, #{c.chunkIndex}, #{c.content}, #{c.tokenCount}, #{c.embedding}::vector, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FALSE)
mapper.sql: c.id, c.knowledge_base_id, c.document_id, c.content, d.title as document_title, d.file_name
mapper.select:
select , 1 - (c.embedding <=> #{queryVector}::vector) as similarity from document_chunk c join knowledge_document d on d.id = c.document_id and d.deleted = false where c.deleted = false and c.embedding is not null
order by c.embedding <=> #{queryVector}::vector asc limit #{topK}

select , word_similarity(#{keyword}, c.content) as similarity from document_chunk c join knowledge_document d on d.id = c.document_id and d.deleted = false where c.deleted = false and (#{keyword} <% c.content or c.content ilike '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
order by word_similarity(#{keyword}, c.content) desc limit #{topK}
